title: The crab in the margin
logline: February 14, 2027: a page that is mostly margin. The flats small at the center, and in the bottom corner where the word goes, the crab beside it, drawn larger than it has ever been. The page's only joke about itself.

margin.note: The crab, larger than it has ever been, beside the word.

panels.composition: A page that is mostly blank paper with a small drawing of mudflats at its center and, in the bottom corner, a tiny word beside a crab drawn larger than usual.
